pal/spotify.markdown:
# Spotify

Search, play, queue, like and add to a playlist on Spotify from the panel, with a lyrics view that follows the song and a bar item that shows the line playing.

## Palettes

- Lyrics
- Search Spotify
- Playlists
- Library
- Spotify Devices
- Queue
- Spotify

![The lyrics view: the cover, the progress, the line playing bright among the lines around it](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/spotify/screenshots/1-lyrics.png)
![Search: tracks, artists, albums, playlists and podcasts as sections](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/spotify/screenshots/2-search.png)
![Playlists: yours and the followed ones; cmd+enter lists a playlist's tracks](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/spotify/screenshots/3-playlists.png)
![Library: Liked Songs newest first, the other filters on Tab](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/spotify/screenshots/4-library.png)
![The queue: what plays now, what comes next, Enter skips to a row](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/spotify/screenshots/5-queue.png)

pal/onepassword.markdown:
# 1Password

Your 1Password items through the op CLI. Enter copies the password; username, one-time code and the app are in the action panel.

## Palettes

- 1Password

![Items with their vault, username and website, favourites first](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/onepassword/screenshots/1-items.png)
![The detail pane (cmd+I): vault, category, username, website, tags and when it was last updated](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/onepassword/screenshots/2-detail.png)
![Copy the password, the username or the one-time code, or open the app](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/onepassword/screenshots/3-actions.png)
![The vault dropdown (Tab) narrows the list to one of the vaults in the settings: Work](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/onepassword/screenshots/4-vault.png)

pal/2048.markdown:
# 2048

The sliding-tile game in the panel, keyboard only: arrows or hjkl move, N starts over, U takes a move back. The board and the best score persist.

## Palettes

- 2048

![Mid-game: the score, the best and the move count above the board, the keys under it](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/2048/screenshots/1-board.png)
![The first 2048: keep going or start over](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/2048/screenshots/2-won.png)
![Game over: no move left, the score, Enter for a new game](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/2048/screenshots/3-over.png)

pal/apps.markdown:
# Applications

Installed applications with their own icons: .app bundles on macOS (running ones tagged, with Quit and Hide; the System Settings panes as rows), .desktop entries on Linux (their own actions as secondary actions).

## Palettes

- Applications

![The applications, their source as the subtitle, the running ones tagged](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/apps/screenshots/1-list.png)
![Typing at the root finds an app by its bundle id as well as its name: ical is Calendar (com.apple.iCal)](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/apps/screenshots/2-search.png)
![A running app: Open, Quit, Hide, Reveal in Finder, Copy path, Copy bundle id](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/apps/screenshots/3-actions.png)
![The System Settings panes are rows too, found by what they hold: network finds Network and Wi-Fi](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/apps/screenshots/4-panes.png)

pal/audio.markdown:
# Audio

Output and input devices: switch the default, set the volume, mute.

## Palettes

- Audio

![Outputs and inputs in two sections, the defaults tagged, a muted device marked, the volume on the right](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/audio/screenshots/1-devices.png)
![What a device can do: make it the output, set its volume, mute it](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/audio/screenshots/2-actions.png)
![Set volume with nothing typed in the bar asks for the percent here, 0 to 100](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/audio/screenshots/3-volume.png)

pal/power.markdown:
# Battery & Power

Battery level and time left, and with the optional power watcher everything about where the power goes: the draw over the last hours, what uses power now and why, and what used the battery today, this week and ever, in watt-hours.

## Palettes

- Battery & Power

![Now: the level and six hours of draw on the left; the warning, where the watts go and what uses them on the right](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/power/screenshots/1-now.png)
![Today: what used the battery in watt-hours with each one's share, the screen and the rest explained](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/power/screenshots/2-today.png)
![7 days: where the week's watt-hours went, the costliest process under the cursor a key away from Processes](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/power/screenshots/3-week.png)

pal/blackjack.markdown:
# Blackjack

Blackjack on a felt table with a real deck: arrows and Enter play a hand one-handed (up hit, down stand), or click the moves. The bankroll and the record persist.

## Palettes

- Blackjack

![A blackjack: 3:2 on the $50 bet, the winnings stacked beside it](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/blackjack/screenshots/1-blackjack.png)
![Mid-hand after a split: hand 1 is being played, the hole card is face down](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/blackjack/screenshots/2-hand.png)
![Settled: the dealer drew and bust, the winnings stacked on the bet, the bankroll moved](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/blackjack/screenshots/3-settled.png)
![Placing a bet: the chips on the felt, up and down move it by the minimum, Enter deals](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/blackjack/screenshots/4-bet.png)

pal/bluetooth.markdown:
# Bluetooth

Paired devices: connect, disconnect, see the battery.

## Palettes

- Bluetooth

![Paired devices, the connected ones first with their battery, the AirPods bud by bud](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/bluetooth/screenshots/1-devices.png)
![A device that is away: connect it, or copy its address](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/bluetooth/screenshots/2-actions.png)
![Enter on a connected device disconnects it, after asking](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/bluetooth/screenshots/3-disconnect.png)

pal/github.markdown:
# GitHub

Your pull requests, issues, repositories and notifications, and a search over all of GitHub. Signs in through the gh CLI or a token.

## Palettes

- Pull Requests
- Issues
- Repositories
- Notifications
- Search GitHub

![Pull Requests: Mine, Review requested and Merged, with the checks and the review decision on each row](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/github/screenshots/1-prs.png)
![The pane a pull request opens with: the body, the latest comments and reviews, every check by name](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/github/screenshots/2-pr-detail.png)
![Notifications by reason, newest first; the first row is the unread count](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/github/screenshots/3-notifications.png)
![Search GitHub: repositories, issues, pull requests and users for one query](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/github/screenshots/4-search.png)

pal/calc.markdown:
# Calculator

Evaluates what you type: arithmetic, units, currencies, percentages, dates and time zones.

## Palettes

- Calculator

![12 usd to try at the ECB's rate, the reverse as the second row; the pane shows the rate, its inverse and where it comes from](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/calc/screenshots/1-currency.png)
![A day count, with the weeks and months on the right](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/calc/screenshots/2-dates.png)
![10:00 UTC in Tokyo, the full date there as the second row](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/calc/screenshots/3-timezone.png)
![What a result can do: copy, paste into the app in front, copy without formatting](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/calc/screenshots/4-actions.png)

pal/timer.markdown:
# Timer

Named countdown timers over the `timer` CLI: the soonest one on the bar with a fill and a red alarm when it lands, the list, pause, resume and stop in the palette; a pomodoro mode that cycles work and break timers and counts the rounds.

## Palettes

- Timers

![Every timer, the most urgent first: one that just landed, three running with when each lands, one paused, and the pomodoros done today](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/timer/screenshots/1-timers.png)
![A running timer's actions: pause it, stop it, or add the minutes in the field beside the search (five unless you type more)](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/timer/screenshots/2-actions.png)
![A pomodoro round is a timer too: its row says the round and the phase, and skips to the break or stops the cycle](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/timer/screenshots/3-pomodoro.png)
![New timer, typed after the search: a duration as you would say it, an optional name, and whether the phone rings when it lands](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/timer/screenshots/4-new.png)

pal/otp.markdown:
# Verification Codes

One-time codes from your recent text messages, newest first. Enter pastes the code into the app in front.

## Palettes

- Verification Codes

![Today's codes and yesterday's: the sender, the message, the code as a green tag, how long ago it came](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/otp/screenshots/1-codes.png)
![The detail pane: the whole message, the code, the sender with its number, when it was received](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/otp/screenshots/2-detail.png)
![Paste the code into the app in front, copy it (concealed, gone in 30 s), or copy the sender](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/otp/screenshots/3-actions.png)
